d: Chestnut brown hair, short with straight-cut bangs and a soft texture. Golden-brown eyes with a cheerful, wide-eyed expression. Appears as a mature adolescent. Slim build wearing a white off-the-shoulder blouse, a dark navy blue lace-up corset, and a black choker. Accessories include round wire-rimmed glasses, a dark blue aviator cap with a gold-trimmed visor and star emblems, brass goggles perched on the forehead, and large white curved horns protruding from the sides of the head.
